build_openapi_spec_request_bodies: build an OpenAPI spec with expanded request body schemas for chat completions, embeddings, and responses API endpoints
create_pydantic_schema_from_model: create a JSON schema dict from a Pydantic model class, supporting both v1 and v2 APIs
add_schema_to_openapi_components: add a Pydantic model schema definition to the components/schemas section of an OpenAPI spec
expand_request_body_for_swagger: expand a Pydantic field definition into an inline OpenAPI schema for better Swagger UI form display
rewrite_pydantic_defs_refs: rewrite Pydantic v2 $defs references from #/$defs/ to #/components/schemas/ for OpenAPI compatibility
